sources.title: Placeholder Labs
sources.snippet: Placeholder Labs exists as an AI partner for software companies to help them customise, host and continuously improve open source models that fit into the Placeholder sized gap in their product.

sources.title: Locus-1 Pretrain Mix - a placeholderlabs Collection
sources.snippet: Regular-context pretraining releases: documents plus aligned Dolma-2 tokens and masks, one repo per source mix. Token counts on each card.

sources.title: Locus-1 Pretrain Long-Context Mix - a placeholderlabs Collection
sources.snippet: Long-context (16K packing) pretraining releases, same two-parquet contract as the regular mixes. Token counts on each card.

sources.title: Can I run AI locally? Best models for your GPU
sources.snippet: Detect your GPU or Mac and see which open LLMs, coding, image and video models you can run locally. VRAM requirements, speed estimates and grades.
